Product Description
This Ethernet media converter realizes the conversion of signals between fiber optic and copper twisted-pair.
The maximum network transmission distance can be increased to more than 100Km.
It supports
link fault alarm
wide operating temperature range
port and power surge protection
and meets deployment requirements in outdoor monitoring environments such as rail transit, safe city, and intelligent transportation.
